description: A bezier envelope with no sustain stage. The shape is drawn from two to six nodes with a control point between each pair, and the nodes are dragged by hand on the display. It is polyphonic

params.text: A tap starts the envelope by hand
Sets the length of the whole envelope within the range chosen in the menu; the knob is exponential, so the short end of the range is spread out
Runs the envelope over and over instead of once per trigger
Draws the envelope from that many nodes, with a control point between each neighbouring pair; each count keeps its own shape, so switching back brings the earlier one up again

inputs.text: A trigger starts the envelope; one to sixteen channels are accepted, and the number of channels sets how many voices run

outputs.text: The envelope voltage, one polyphonic channel per voice, over -5V to 5V or 0-10V as the menu sets
A pulse at the end of each run of the envelope, in loop mode as well as after a trigger

notes: dragging a node with shift held quantises it to 0.5V steps, and dragging with the command key held moves it slowly for fine work
BZ-XPAND placed immediately to the right gives CV control of every node and control point
BZ-XPANDXPAND placed immediately to the right of BZ-XPAND adds a scale and an offset for each of its CV inputs
menu: ENVELOPE TIME RANGES — the span the duration knob works over: From 0.001 seconds to 0.100 seconds, From 0.100 seconds to 1 second, From 1 second to 10 seconds, From 10 seconds to 60 seconds
CV MODES — on the display's own right-click menu, switches the output between 5 Volts either way and 0-10 Volts
ZOOM MODES — on the zoom area's own right-click menu, sets how far the display is stretched vertically
